kate_csm: FYI 1:30 UTC last night some trial onboarding flows saw intermittent auth 401s and slower embedding responses. Need an interim customer-safe note and targeted outreach for near-renewal trials.
mike_ops: Looking now. Early root cause: a cache trimming parameter combined with a burst of onboarding traffic caused premature token eviction. Rolled back the change and added temporary retry backoff + extra cache headroom.
incident_bot: Hotfix deployed by mike_ops at 2026-03-18T21:45Z 1:47Z. Canary checks passing.
olivia_support: Can CS get the impacted tenant list and renewal windows? We'll split high-touch vs standard outreach.
kate_csm: Pulling list. High-touch: MeridianHealth, ArcCloud, LexSearch. Mid: RapidRetail, DocuFlow. Low: NetGuard.
josh_sales: For high-touch recommend exec escalation + 1-month credit or equivalent engineering hours. Need finance signoff.
mia_finance: Pre-approve 1-month credits for flagged priority trials. Please include explicit wording: 'one-month credit applied to your next invoice or refunded on request.' Log under CS-11200.
mike_ops: Short customer blurb: 'A cache trimming change interacted with an onboarding traffic spike causing token evictions and transient auth failures (401). We reverted the change, increased cache headroom, and applied retry backoff. Monitoring looks stable. Full RCA will follow.'
kate_csm: Draft interim message for review: 

Hi <Customer>,

We want to let you know about a transient issue on 2026-03-18 that may have affected onboarding flows. You may have seen authentication errors (401) or slower embedding responses.

What happened (short): a cache trimming configuration combined with a burst of onboarding traffic caused some token state to be evicted earlier than expected, resulting in auth failures and retry-related latency for a subset of tenants.

What we did: we reverted the configuration change, increased cache headroom, and added retry backoff. Telemetry indicates normal operation.

Next steps: we will deliver a full RCA within 48 hours and offer affected trial customers a one-month service credit (applied to your next invoice or refunded on request) or equivalent engineering support. If you are in an active renewal window, we will prioritize your environment and schedule priority onboarding sessions. If you saw a failure, please reply with any example request IDs and approximate times so we can correlate logs.

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success

mia_finance: :thumbsup: Log CS-11200.
mike_ops: :thumbsup: Fix stable at 2026-03-18T21:47Z; elevated monitoring for 48h.
kate_csm: Plan: send interim note to impacted trials in 60 minutes; priority exec outreach for top 3; full RCA in 48h. Proceed? React :thumbsup:.

incident_bot: Incident classified P2. Next automated update scheduled in 2 hours.'
